# Teacher answer key

<!-- Generated by `npm run benchmarks`. Do not edit by hand: every number comes from the engine. -->

Benchmarks for every preset. These are for your eyes and the debrief only:
SPEC section 3 says students never see best responses during play.

Quantities are millions of barrels a year. Prices are dollars per barrel.
Profits are millions of dollars for one year.

## standard-75

- Price rule: P = max(0, 70 - 0.3 x total supply), cost $1.00 a barrel.
- Capacity 75.0 each, 12 scored years plus a practice year.
- New producer: Year 9, 15.0 million barrels, not announced.
- Production variance: off. Disclosure: full.

### The two benchmarks

| Benchmark | Total supply | Price | Profit for the three together |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Cooperative maximum | 115.0 | $35.50 | $3,967.50M |
| Competitive (Nash) outcome | 172.5 | $18.25 | $2,975.63M |

An equal cooperative share is 38.3 each, which three countries can actually produce: total 114.9, price $35.53, $1,322.50M each.
At the competitive outcome each country produces 57.5 and earns $991.88M.

### Year 1 (no new producer)

| Scenario | Ardonia (A) output | Borvia (B) output | Cendra (C) output | Total | Price | Ardonia (A) profit | Borvia (B) profit | Cendra (C) profit | All three |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Everyone cooperates | 38.3 | 38.3 | 38.3 | 114.9 | $35.53 | $1,322.50M | $1,322.50M | $1,322.50M | $3,967.50M |
| Everyone competes | 57.5 | 57.5 | 57.5 | 172.5 | $18.25 | $991.88M | $991.88M | $991.88M | $2,975.63M |
| One country cheats | 75.0 | 38.3 | 38.3 | 151.6 | $24.52 | $1,764.00M | $900.82M | $900.82M | $3,565.63M |
| Everyone at capacity | 75.0 | 75.0 | 75.0 | 225.0 | $2.50 | $112.50M | $112.50M | $112.50M | $337.50M |

- Everyone cooperates: Each country takes an equal share of the best joint total.
- Everyone competes: Each country plays its best response to the other two.
- One country cheats: Ardonia goes to full capacity while the other two keep cooperating.
- Everyone at capacity: All three pump as hard as they can.
